summary: Iteration 35: verified Framer-grade design_v2 default for NEW tenants + export parity + v2 public preview. Backend suite (7/7) all green: new tenants get design_v2=true with Sora/Inter; two old tenants (app_7a2cd286a360, app_e3cb4f084785) unchanged; premium-rebuild upgrades design_v2 to true; v2 exported styles.css contains --t-h1 clamp + sticky glass nav + .fx-stagger and exported HTML contains fx-stagger grids and loading='lazy' images; non-v2 export does NOT contain --t-h1. Frontend v2 public preview loads with .dsv2 root, hero full 100svh, backdrop-filter navbar, fluid h1 (84px @1920 / 81.92px @1280 / 42.76px @390), hero image is NOT lazy (fetchpriority=high, decoding=async). HOWEVER two visible issues on the public preview: (1) sticky glass navbar scrolls off screen — top goes to -1440 after scrollTo(1500) — because each block is wrapped in an EffectWrap motion.div (only 85px tall for the navbar block) with an always-applied style={{y}} transform, which both creates a containing block that neutralises position:sticky AND limits the sticky range to 85px; (2) 390px mobile viewport shows horizontal overflow (scrollWidth 542 vs innerWidth 390) coming from the Emergent Preview chrome bar (chip + page tab list at the very top of /p/), not from the tenant site itself — still user-visible on mobile. Font on demo tenant is Manrope (design_v2=true but per-tenant editable so acceptable). React warning: should use fetchPriority in JSX.

ui_bugs.issue: Sticky glass navbar (.tglassnav) does NOT stay visible while scrolling. Each block including the navbar is wrapped in EffectWrap (motion.div with style={{y}}). Two combined causes: (a) EffectWrap always applies a transform via style={{y}} — a transformed ancestor becomes the containing block and neutralises position:sticky; (b) the wrapper element only spans the nav's own height (~85px), so even without the transform sticky would only stick for 85px of scroll. Ancestry inspection confirmed: nav parent DIV.tstagger-in height=85, all ancestors static/visible with transform:none only because style.y currently resolves to 0 — but framer-motion still promotes to composite. Actual computed scroll test: window.scrollTo(0,1500) leaves the nav at top=-1440 (off-screen).

At 390px viewport the top preview toolbar (Design V2 Demo pill + Home/About/Services/Contact tab list + eye icon + external-link button) does not wrap — scrollWidth=542 vs innerWidth=390, causing horizontal overflow on mobile. Offenders: div.flex.items-center.gap-3 (right=542), a.flex.items-center.gap-1.5 (right=542). Tenant site content itself does not overflow, but the preview chrome makes the page horizontally scrollable on mobile.
React DOM warning: 'Invalid DOM property `fetchpriority`. Did you mean `fetchPriority`?' — attribute is being passed lowercase in JSX. Functionally works (attribute is set) but noisy in console.

issues: theme.font_body is still 'Manrope' (not 'Inter') because the demo tenant was created before Sora/Inter became the default. design_v2=true so all v2 CSS still applies; new tenants correctly seed Sora/Inter.

action_items: FIX sticky navbar: either (a) don't wrap navbar blocks in EffectWrap, or render them outside the mapped block list; or (b) make EffectWrap omit style={{y}} when parallax is not enabled AND use display:contents / a non-transformed wrapper for sticky-friendly blocks like navbar; the cleanest fix is to detect block.type==='navbar' and skip EffectWrap for it.
FIX mobile preview toolbar overflow at ≤390px — allow wrap / hide chip labels / horizontal-scroll the tab list so the whole page does not overflow horizontally.
Rename to fetchPriority in JSX (BlockPreview.jsx hero cover image).
Optional: retrofit v2 demo tenant fonts to Sora/Inter to make the demo match the new default.
critical_code_review_comments: EffectWrap always sets style={{y}} even when effects.parallax is false (par=0, but framer-motion still creates a motion transform on the element). This forces every block's wrapper to become a stacking + containing-block context, which is why position:sticky inside navbar is broken. Consider only setting style when parallax is truly enabled.

PublicPreview.jsx wraps every block including navbar in the same EffectWrap; navbar is a page-level chrome element and should live at the page root above the AnimatePresence page-mapping, so it can be sticky across the whole scroll container.

rca of the issue: Sticky nav: PublicPreview.jsx line 60 renders each block (navbar included) inside <EffectWrap>, which is a framer-motion motion.div that always applies style={{y: useTransform(...)}}. Even with parallax disabled (par=0) the motion-value driven transform is still present on the DOM node, and a transformed ancestor becomes the containing block for sticky descendants, preventing the navbar from sticking to the viewport. Additionally the EffectWrap div only wraps the navbar block itself (height ~85px), so sticky range is bounded by 85px. Reproduce: open the v2 preview URL, scrollBy(0,600) — nav disappears with the scroll. Mitigation: render navbar outside the .map, or short-circuit EffectWrap when block.type==='navbar' (return <>{children}</>). Mobile overflow: preview toolbar div.flex.items-center.gap-3 does not wrap at 390px because the tab list is inline. Mitigation: overflow-x:auto on the tab list or hide the chip on <sm.
